subject: Post-demo: Data retention & deletion SLAs (SOC2/GDPR/HIPAA)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@amaya.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T14:05:00Z
Subject: Post-demo: Data retention & deletion SLAs (SOC2/GDPR/HIPAA)

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we can keep momentum on the procurement side: 

1) SOC 2 / compliance evidence: you flagged SOC 2 Type II and GDPR/HIPAA posture as blockers for legal/security review. We can share our latest security overview and bridge letter while the Type II report is final.

2) Data retention & deletion specifics: you asked for explicit SLAs covering primary data, backups, and logs (including retention windows and purge timing for backups). You also mentioned a requirement to confirm whether backups can be purged within 30 days in a contractual commitment.

3) Vendor security questionnaire: you said you'll send the Amaya standard questionnaire. We'll start pre-filling it and route to security for any deeper technical responses.

Our immediate next steps from here: 
- I will attach a short security overview and our SOC2 bridge letter for your review (attached).
- Can you please send the vendor questionnaire (if you haven't already) or confirm the preferred format (Excel / Doc / vendor portal)?
- Rishi from Sales Ops will own any contract-level redlines around deletion SLAs. Marissa (CS) will be available for technical follow-ups if Amaya needs deeper log/backup details.

To be explicit on what I can confirm now (pre-internal legal sign-off):
- Active customer data deletion: we can remove data from primary (live) storage within 48 hours of a valid request.
- Logical deletion vs physical purge: full physical purge from backups is dependent on backup schedule and retention policy; standard hosted plan purge from backups completes within 90 days.
- Log retention: security/audit logs are retained for 365 days by default; we can scope that during contract negotiation.

If Amaya requires a shorter backup purge window (30 days) as part of contract, we can evaluate a SOC/contract addendum or Private deployment option (which provides stronger isolation and can support shorter backup retention for regulated data). Rishi — flagging for pricing / Dedicated/Private options.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call with your security team if helpful.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf, SOC2-bridge-letter-202603.pdf

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@amaya.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Amaya Security <security@amaya.com>
Date: 2026-03-16T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Data retention & deletion SLAs (SOC2/GDPR/HIPAA)

Neha —

Thanks for the recap and for the quick turnaround. A few items from our side: 

- Appreciate the bridge letter and overview. We need the SOC 2 Type II report or a signed bridge/attestation showing the assessment window and expected delivery date. Can you confirm target delivery? Our legal team usually requires either the report or an attestation within the procurement packet.

- On retention & deletion: Amaya's risk team is asking for: 
  * Confirmation that primary customer data can be deleted on request and that deletion from active storage occurs within 72 hours; 48 hours would be great to see in writing.
  * Clarify backups: default 90 days is okay, but they asked whether Redwood can contractually commit to purging copies from backups within 30 days in the event of a customer-initiated deletion. This is an important point for our GDPR workflows.
  * Logs: we need audit logs and access logs retained for at least 90 days (minimum) and ideally 365 days.

- We attached our vendor security questionnaire (Excel). Please have your security team prefill the sections on encryption, key management, data residency, incident response, and backup retention.

- One follow-up: does Redwood treat backups as immutable snapshots (i.e., cannot be modified) or do you have a process to remove specific customer data from backup snapshots?

Happy to set up a call between our security/compliance lead and your security team next week.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform Security, Amaya Inc.
liam@amaya.com | +1 (617) 555-0123

Attachments: Amaya_Vendor_Questionnaire.xlsx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@amaya.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Amaya Security <security@amaya.com>
Date: 2026-03-16T18:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Data retention & deletion SLAs (SOC2/GDPR/HIPAA)

Liam / Amaya security team —

Thanks — got the questionnaire and shared it with our security & compliance team. Quick answers to the items you flagged and attachments we can share immediately: Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf (attached), SOC2-bridge-letter-202603.pdf (attached). We also started a prefilled version of your spreadsheet; expect the initial pass from our security team tomorrow.

Direct answers to the retention/purge questions you raised: 

- SOC 2: We have an active SOC 2 Type II program. Our most recent assessment completed in Q4 2025; the formal Type II report will be provided under NDA. The SOC2-bridge-letter attached summarizes scope and dates — target to share the report under NDA by 2026-04-10. If you need interim attestation sooner we can provide a signed executive attestation and our public control mapping (see security overview).

- Primary data deletion: We commit to removing customer data from active (primary) storage within 48 hours of a validated deletion request. We will provide a deletion confirmation timestamp and audit log entry for each request.

- Backups & purge: Our hosted backups are standard immutable snapshots with a scheduled retention cycle. Standard hosted plan: backups retained for 90 days. For a contractual commitment to purge from backups within 30 days, we typically evaluate two options: 
  1) Private deployment (VPC/managed on-prem) or Dedicated clusters with custom backup policies (recommended for strict GDPR/HIPAA requirements).
  2) Contract addendum for Hosted with a backup purge SLA — this requires a technical runbook (how snapshots are remediated) and an operational commitment, which we can scope and price.

Note: in practice, removing specific data from immutable snapshots requires snapshot rehydration & re-snapshotting of affected volumes or keyed backups; this is operationally expensive which is why we commonly recommend Private/Dedicated for short backup purge SLAs. We’ll include this explanation in the prefilled questionnaire.

- Log retention: We retain audit and access logs for 365 days by default for security purposes. We can negotiate shorter or longer windows in contract. For HIPAA workloads we advise Private deployments (with customer-managed keys) and can support tailored retention.

- Encryption / KMS: Data at rest and in transit is encrypted. We support customer-managed keys for Dedicated and Private deployments. Details are in the attached security overview.

Next steps I propose: 
- We will upload the completed Amaya_Vendor_Questionnaire.xlsx with our security responses by EOD tomorrow.
- Rishi will scope two commercial options in parallel: Hosted (with contractual backup-purge addendum scoped) and Dedicated/Private (with shorter backup retention). Expect a note from him by end of week with pricing delta and timelines.
- If Amaya security wants a working session, Marissa is available Wednesday/Thursday morning PST to walk through the technical backup lifecycle and log access controls.

Let me know if you want NDA in place for the SOC 2 report exchange; we can route a standard mutual NDA through DocuSign.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf, SOC2-bridge-letter-202603.pdf, (prefilled questionnaire to follow)
